note: Snapshot centerIdx finally reaches buildSnapshot. v5.37.14 added the optional centerIdx parameter to buildSnapshot for the right-click neighborhood mode, and the call chain was right at both ends (right-click handler called copySnapshot(11, centerIdx) and buildSnapshot accepted barCount and centerIdx), but the function in the middle was defined as copySnapshot(barCount) only so centerIdx got dropped on the floor. Every snapshot returned the tail regardless of which bar the user clicked. One-line fix: copySnapshot now accepts and forwards centerIdx. The snapshot tool's first real bug was caught by the snapshot tool itself.
